limits: NR configuration/readback is verified, but no captured client request, response receipt or use is established. Missing DEBUG/MSGDUMP messages are not evidence of absent frames.

Baseline and NR are different associations. This trial additionally enables a hostapd runtime logging setting and reader; compile-time filtering limits observability and logging overhead is not identically controlled.
Matching configured TCP target and channel-request order does not establish equal instantaneous traffic, RF dwell, scan execution or channel conditions.
Single association, not a paired experiment or proof of Air sleep/wake repair.
Scan requests and API call intervals do not measure RF dwell; zero observed records do not prove absence.
PS events are host notifications. Emitted kernel continuity does not restore rate-limited events or prove final wake latency.
Global P/F sequence gaps exclude other peers before target filtering; unobserved boundary events remain unknown.
BATRACE is observed frame/preparation logging and BAMCU is command return; neither proves delivery or operational BA. No aggregate-status inference is made.
Server TCP and client intervals have separate relative starts and rounding; retransmits are not a wire-loss counter.

configured_load.authority: Actual iperf start.test_start and command; configured TCP rate is not an instantaneous cap.

neighbor_configuration.capture_limitation: Saved r41 config, hostapd Makefile and prepared wpa_debug.h show minimum priority 3, excluding DEBUG/MSGDUMP. Runtime MSGDUMP selection cannot restore omitted messages; receipt/use is unverified.
